name: Patryna
source:
A maid from Northern Europe who serves the Ootorimine family. She has a calm and composed personality, always maintaining a professional distance as a servant and walking one step behind [url=/c163310]Nazca[/url]. After taking care of chores for the domestically-challenged Nazca, she returns to the Ootorimine mansion, from which she commutes to school.
